description: This line plot illustrates the progression of “Accuracy Token Prediction (Next)” for two experimental conditions, labeled “Ex1 Accuracy” and “Ex2 Accuracy,” as a function of training “Step,” ranging from 0 to 600,000. The x-axis, labeled “Step,” is linearly scaled with major tick marks at intervals of 100,000. The y-axis, labeled “Accuracy Token Prediction (Next),” is also linearly scaled, ranging from 0.10 to 0.40, with tick marks at intervals of 0.05. The “Ex1 Accuracy” line, rendered in dark blue with circular markers and a solid line, begins at approximately 0.24 at Step 0, rises sharply to about 0.39 by Step 50,000, and then plateaus near 0.41 from Step 200,000 onward. The “Ex2 Accuracy” line, shown in cyan with circular markers and a solid line, starts at approximately 0.09 at Step 0, increases to 0.27 by Step 50,000, reaches 0.29 by Step 100,000, and continues to climb gradually to approximately 0.39 by Step 600,000. Both lines show monotonic increases over time, with Ex1 consistently outperforming Ex2 across all measured steps.
